title: sambucus cerulea var. glauca
intro: Sambucus cerulea var. glauca, commonly known as Blue Elderberry, is a deciduous shrub native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. It is valued for its rich history of traditional use, particularly in herbal medicine, where it is used to address a range of health issues. The plant is known to provide health benefits such as immune system support, anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties, which can aid in the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Sambucus cerulea var. glauca include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities.
